name: Kanou Tchikai
source:
"Hm Hm? Are you embarrassed? Kyahahahaha♪ How cute★"
"Just like this truth your ears, and cheeks are all red." 

Position: Analysis
Weapon: n/a

The oldest of the team.
He is honest and kind, he may be 28 but he acts younger than Mict who is the youngest.
He is knowledgeable about [Star], its components, types and an abundance of other things, every night he is investigating on his computer about it and there are still lots of puzzling parts about them.
He likes everything sweet, if presented with a salty food on the table he will eat it with sweet sauce on top of it.

[Edited from [url=http://cannonette.tumblr.com/post/90317810847/binary-star-main-characters]Cannonette[/url]]
